citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:35 am on August
19, 2026. The inspector contacted licensee via phone call upon arrival. Licensee answered the call indicating he was out
of town making a delivery and that no one else would be able to assist with the inspection. Failure to provide access to
the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide
access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
